data.one_liner: Cross-platform isolated worker runtime for Dart Web, VM, and Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a cross-platform concurrency solution allowing execution of background tasks in isolated workers. Supports Dart Web, VM, and Flutter, including Web Assembly compatibility.
use_when: You need a cross-platform isolated worker runtime for internal Amplify client requirements
avoid_when: You need officially supported concurrency tools for external use, as the maintainers state there are currently no plans to support this externally
strengths: Cross-platform support across Dart Web, VM, and Flutter
weaknesses: Experimental multiplatform solution used internally in Amplify client libraries
No current plans to support external use
